spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  SUM(bit_count)/$__interval_s AS in_rate
FROM
  data_flow AS flow
  INNER JOIN meta_interface AS ifin ON ifin.ref = flow.in_interface_ref
WHERE
  src_as_id = '$as'
  AND in_interface_edge = true
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  SUM(bit_count)/$__interval_s AS out_rate
FROM
  data_flow AS flow
  INNER JOIN meta_interface AS ifout ON ifout.ref = flow.out_interface_ref
WHERE
  dst_as_id = '$as'
  AND out_interface_edge = true
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  out_interface_id,
  SUM(bit_count)/8 AS volume
FROM
  data_flow AS flow
WHERE
  dst_as_id='${as}'
  AND out_interface_edge=true
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY
  out_interface_id
ORDER BY
  volume DESC
LIMIT 1000

spec.title: Top IP Pairs When Source AS is $as

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  src_ip,
  dst_ip,
  SUM(bit_count)/$__interval_s AS rate
FROM
  data_flow AS flow
WHERE
-- Limit to top AS pairs for entire time range by volume, then outer query just grabs those pairs
  (src_ip, dst_ip) IN (
    SELECT
      (src_ip, dst_ip)
    FROM
      data_flow
    WHERE
      src_as_id='${as}'
      AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
    GROUP BY
      src_ip,
      dst_ip
    ORDER BY
      SUM(bit_count) DESC
    LIMIT
      1000
  )
  AND src_as_id='${as}'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  src_ip,
  dst_ip,
  time
ORDER BY
  time ASC,
  rate DESC
